cases.proposed_obligation: A surviving workflow loses its only known test execution with no replacement in the owned tree
cases.authority: #181 accepted residual must be explicitly narrowed; no blanket warn-to-high upgrade

.github/workflows/ci.yml.before:
name: owned
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m pytest tests
.github/workflows/ci.yml.after:
name: owned
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

cases.proposed_obligation: A script called by the same live workflow preserves the exact test command, working directory and fail propagation
cases.authority: Concrete behavior/label disposition needed before adopting expectations

.github/workflows/ci.yml.after:
name: owned
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: bash scripts/test.sh
